results.text: Efficacy and safety of azilsartan medoxomil in the treatment of hypertension: a systematic review and meta-analysis. Angiotensin II receptor blockers (ARBs) are utilized for the management of hypertension and diabetes. Previous meta-analyses suggested that azilsartan medoxomil (AZL-M) improved blood pressure (BP) reduction, but there were no safety findings or suggestions for patients with hypertension or diabetes.
